text_en: In the one hundred seventy-second year King Demetrius assembled his forces and marched into Media to obtain help, so that he could make war against Trypho.
text_cn: 一百七十二年， 德默特琉王调集军队，开往玛待，以求获得兵源，好与特黎丰决战。

text_en: When King Arsaces of Persia and Media heard that Demetrius had invaded his territory, he sent one of his generals to take him alive.
text_cn: 波斯和玛待王阿尔撒革听说德默特琉已侵入他的边境，就派遣自己一员大将去活捉他。

text_en: The general went and defeated the army of Demetrius, and seized him and took him to Arsaces, who put him under guard.
text_cn: 这位大将前往，击败了德默特琉的军队，将他捉住，解到阿尔撒革王前，阿尔撒革将他囚在监里。

text_en: The land had rest all the days of Simon. He sought the good of his nation; his rule was pleasing to them, as was the honor shown him, all his days.
text_cn: 息孟执政期间，犹太国泰民安，他只谋求自己民族的福利，因此对他的统治，人民心悦诚服，他的荣耀一生常存。

text_en: To crown all his honors he took Joppa for a harbor, and opened a way to the isles of the sea.
text_cn: 除此荣耀外，又占据了约培，建为海港，辟作通往海岛的口岸；

text_en: He extended the borders of his nation, and gained full control of the country.
text_cn: 他开拓了本国的疆域，全国都在他权下。

text_en: He gathered a host of captives; he ruled over Gazara and Beth-zur and the citadel, and he removed its uncleanness from it; and there was none to oppose him.
text_cn: 他安置了大批战俘，征服了革则尔、贝特族尔和耶路撒冷的堡垒；除去城中的不洁，没有人能敌抗他。

text_en: They tilled their land in peace; the ground gave its increase, and the trees of the plains their fruit.
text_cn: 人都平安耕种田地，土地按时出产，平原上的树木依时结果。

text_en: Old men sat in the streets; they all talked together of good things, and the youths put on splendid military attire.
text_cn: 老者闲坐街头，众人谈论公益，少年身穿盛服和军装。

text_en: He supplied the towns with food, and furnished them with the means of defense, until his renown spread to the ends of the earth.
text_cn: 他为各城储存食粮，用防御工事巩固城池；因此，他的名声传遍了天涯地角。

text_en: He established peace in the land, and Israel rejoiced with great joy.
text_cn: 他使本国得享平安，以色列人皆大喜欢。

text_en: All the people sat under their own vines and fig trees, and there was none to make them afraid.
text_cn: 每人安坐在自己的葡萄树及无花果树下，无人前来惊吓。

text_en: No one was left in the land to fight them, and the kings were crushed in those days.
text_cn: 那时，国内敌人已经绝迹，列王已被击退。

text_en: He gave help to all the humble among his people; he sought out the law, and did away with all the renegades and outlaws.
text_cn: 凡国内低下小民，他都予以扶持；他寻求法律，而铲除一切恶徒败类；

text_en: He made the sanctuary glorious, and added to the vessels of the sanctuary.
text_cn: 他尽量使圣殿壮观，增添圣所里的器皿。

text_en: It was heard in Rome, and as far away as Sparta, that Jonathan had died, and they were deeply grieved.
text_cn: 罗马人及斯巴达人听说约纳堂死了，都很哀伤。

text_en: When they heard that his brother Simon had become high priest in his stead, and that he was ruling over the country and the towns in it,
text_cn: 他们一听说他哥哥息孟继任作大司祭，掌管国家及各城邑，

text_en: they wrote to him on bronze tablets to renew with him the friendship and alliance that they had established with his brothers Judas and Jonathan.
text_cn: 便用铜版给他写信，重新与他缔结友好盟约，就如从前与他弟弟犹大和约纳堂所缔结的盟约一样。

text_en: And these were read before the assembly in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 这信就在耶路撒冷会众面前宣读了。

text_en: This is a copy of the letter that the Spartans sent: “The rulers and the city of the Spartans to the high priest Simon and to the elders and the priests and the rest of the Jewish people, our brothers, greetings.
text_cn: 斯巴达人送来的信，抄录如下：“斯巴达人的首领及城邑，祝大司祭息孟，各位长老，司祭及其余犹太人民兄弟们安好！

text_en: The envoys who were sent to our people have told us about your glory and honor, and we rejoiced at their coming.
text_cn: 你们派到我国来的使者，将你们的光荣与尊威，一一告诉了我们；我们对他们的光临，都很喜欢。

text_en: We have recorded what they said in our public decrees, as follows, ‘Numenius son of Antiochus and Antipater son of Jason, envoys of the Jews, have come to us to renew their friendship with us.
text_cn: 他们所说的话，我们也都这样记在国会大事录上：‘犹太人的使者，安提约古的儿子奴默尼，与雅松的儿子安提帕特，来到我们这里，为与我们重订友好盟约，

text_en: It has pleased our people to receive these men with honor and to put a copy of their words in the public archives, so that the people of the Spartans may have a record of them. And they have sent a copy of this to the high priest Simon. ’”
text_cn: 百姓对他们曾予以隆重热烈的欢迎，且将他们的话，记载在国会档案内，为给斯巴达人留作纪念。’我们也将这文件的副本，给大司祭息孟呈写一份。”

text_en: After this Simon sent Numenius to Rome with a large gold shield weighing one thousand minas, to confirm the alliance with the Romans.
text_cn: 此后，息孟又派遣奴默尼赴罗马，他带有大金盾一座，价值约一千“米乃”，以便与他们订立同盟。

text_en: When the people heard these things they said, “How shall we thank Simon and his sons?
text_cn: 民众一听到这些事，就说：“我们要怎样感谢息孟和他的儿子们呢？

text_en: For he and his brothers and the house of his father have stood firm; they have fought and repulsed Israel’s enemies and established its freedom. ”
text_cn: 因为他与他的兄弟们以及他父亲的全家，都表现了英勇的行为，打败了以色列的仇敌，给以色列奠定了自由。”于是他们将这些史迹刻于铜版，嵌在熙雍山的石柱上。

text_en: So they made a record on bronze tablets and put it on pillars on Mount Zion. This is a copy of what they wrote: “On the eighteenth day of Elul, in the one hundred seventy-second year, which is the third year of the great high priest Simon,
text_cn: 其原文如下：“一百七十二年，‘厄路耳’月十八日，大司祭息孟三年，在阿撒辣默耳，

text_en: in Asaramel, in the great assembly of the priests and the people and the rulers of the nation and the elders of the country, the following was proclaimed to us:
text_cn: 有人在司祭、百姓、民众的首领及全国长老盛大集会时，通告我们说：

text_en: “Since wars often occurred in the country, Simon son of Mattathias, a priest of the sons of Joarib, and his brothers, exposed themselves to danger and resisted the enemies of their nation, in order that their sanctuary and the law might be preserved; and they brought great glory to their nation.
text_cn: 当国内在不断战争中，约阿黎布的后裔，玛塔提雅的儿子息孟， 和他的兄弟们，为了支持并维护圣所和法律，冒着性命的危险，抵抗了民族的仇敌，使自己的民族获得了莫大的光荣。

text_en: Jonathan rallied the nation, became their high priest, and was gathered to his people.
text_cn: 在约纳堂统一自己的国家，作了他们的大司祭，归到他亲族那里之后，

text_en: When their enemies decided to invade their country and lay hands on their sanctuary,
text_cn: 犹太人的敌人，便企图进占他们的国境，伸手侵犯圣所；

text_en: then Simon rose up and fought for his nation. He spent great sums of his own money; he armed the soldiers of his nation and paid them wages.
text_cn: 那时息孟起来，为自己的民族而战，花尽了自己的许多钱财，装备了自己人民中的勇士，发给他们粮饷(xiǎng）。

text_en: He fortified the towns of Judea, and Beth-zur on the borders of Judea, where formerly the arms of the enemy had been stored, and he placed there a garrison of Jews.
text_cn: 他曾在犹太各城邑，并在犹太边境上贝特族尔设防；敌人从前曾在那里贮藏过武器，所以他便在那里派了犹太人把守。

text_en: He also fortified Joppa, which is by the sea, and Gazara, which is on the borders of Azotus, where the enemy formerly lived. He settled Jews there, and provided in those towns whatever was necessary for their restoration.
text_cn: 他又巩固了靠海的约培，和位于阿左托边界的革则尔；敌人从前曾盘踞在那里，所以他就派犹太人居住在那里，凡他们所需要的一切，他都给他们准备了。

text_en: “The people saw Simon’s faithfulness and the glory that he had resolved to win for his nation, and they made him their leader and high priest, because he had done all these things and because of the justice and loyalty that he had maintained toward his nation. He sought in every way to exalt his people.
text_cn: 民众见到息孟的忠诚，及为自己民族所获得的光荣，便拥护他作自己的领袖和大司祭，因为他行了这一切事，因为他对自己的民族，持守正义与忠诚；因为他想尽一切方法，高举自己的百姓。

text_en: In his days things prospered in his hands, so that the Gentiles were put out of the country, as were also those in the city of David in Jerusalem, who had built themselves a citadel from which they used to sally forth and defile the environs of the sanctuary, doing great damage to its purity.
text_cn: 他在世时，凡他所行的无不顺利；他将异民从国内赶走，又赶走在耶路撒冷达味城内为自己建造堡垒的人，因为他们时常从堡垒里出来，污辱圣所的四周，侵犯圣所的圣洁。

text_en: He settled Jews in it and fortified it for the safety of the country and of the city, and built the walls of Jerusalem higher.
text_cn: 他派犹太士兵在堡垒里驻守，为了国家与城邑的安全，还巩固了这座堡垒，更加高耶路撒冷的城垣（yuán）。

text_en: “In view of these things King Demetrius confirmed him in the high priesthood,
text_cn: 为此，德默特琉王也委任他为大司祭，

text_en: made him one of his Friends, and paid him high honors.
text_cn: 将他列为自己朋友之一，加给他很大的光荣；

text_en: For he had heard that the Jews were addressed by the Romans as friends and allies and brothers, and that the Romans had received the envoys of Simon with honor.
text_cn: 因为君王曾听说：罗马人称犹太人为朋友，为同盟，为兄弟；又听说他们曾热烈地欢迎息孟的使者。

text_en: “The Jews and their priests have resolved that Simon should be their leader and high priest forever, until a trustworthy prophet should arise,
text_cn: 犹太人和司祭们，都喜欢息孟常作他们的领袖和大司祭，直到一位忠诚的先知兴起为止。

text_en: and that he should be governor over them and that he should take charge of the sanctuary and appoint officials over its tasks and over the country and the weapons and the strongholds, and that he should take charge of the sanctuary,
text_cn: 也喜欢息孟作他们的统帅，要他管理圣所，要他委派人员执行政务，管理疆域、军械与堡垒；

text_en: and that he should be obeyed by all, and that all contracts in the country should be written in his name, and that he should be clothed in purple and wear gold.
text_cn: 喜欢他管理圣所，所有的人都听从他，都以他的名义，书写国内一切公文，并且使他穿上紫袍，戴上金饰。

text_en: “None of the people or priests shall be permitted to nullify any of these decisions or to oppose what he says, or to convene an assembly in the country without his permission, or to be clothed in purple or put on a gold buckle.
text_cn: 无论是平民或司祭，不得废除上述任何一项。他出的命令不得反对。没有他的许可，不得擅自在国内召集会议；不得身穿紫袍，头戴金冠。

text_en: Whoever acts contrary to these decisions or rejects any of them shall be liable to punishment. ”
text_cn: 若有人反对此事，或违犯其中任何一项，便是罪犯。

text_en: All the people agreed to grant Simon the right to act in accordance with these decisions.
text_cn: 全民众都赞成给予息孟按这些话实行的权柄。

text_en: So Simon accepted and agreed to be high priest, to be commander and ethnarch of the Jews and priests, and to be protector of them all.
text_cn: 息孟接受了，也乐意作大司祭，作犹太人及众司祭的统帅和元首，主理一切事务。”

text_en: And they gave orders to inscribe this decree on bronze tablets, to put them up in a conspicuous place in the precincts of the sanctuary,
text_cn: 遂命人将这篇文字，刻于铜版，嵌在圣所墙壁的显明处，

text_en: and to deposit copies of them in the treasury, so that Simon and his sons might have them.
text_cn: 并将副本放在银库里，由息孟及其子孙保管。
